messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's treating you alright. Got a blood pressure reading for me when you have a minute?
Got it, logged. Thanks for getting that in. Anything else going on, or has it been pretty steady?
Pretty quiet. Getting cold up here early this year.
Stay warm out there. I'll send your next check-in same time next week. Talk then.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
